user.title: Thermoplan
user.description: Set up Thermoplan. Rooms are added afterwards via Add room.

data_description.off_mode: Turn the thermostat off, or set a fixed low temperature (some thermostats only accept 4.5 as off).
data_description.off_target: Used when off behavior is a fixed temperature.
data_description.override_minutes: How long a manual change on the thermostat is respected. 0 disables overrides.
data_description.window_sensors: Optional. Only needed if the thermostat does not handle windows itself (e.g. without Better Thermostat).

data_description.off_mode: Turn the thermostat off, or set a fixed low temperature (some thermostats only accept 4.5 as off).
data_description.off_target: Used when off behavior is a fixed temperature.

data_description.window_sensors: Optional. Only needed if the thermostat does not handle windows itself (e.g. without Better Thermostat).

data_description.outdoor_sensor: Used first; the weather entity is used if the sensor is unavailable.
data_description.off_after_minutes: Outdoor temperature must stay at or above the room target for this long.
data_description.on_after_minutes: Outdoor temperature must stay below the room target for this long.
data_description.offset: Added to the room target before comparing.
